description: This file implements a PostgreSQL repository layer for a multi-tenant application, providing functions for CRUD operations, building SQL queries with tenant and optional company scoping, and handling ledger balances. It references external modules such as 'pg' and interacts with external database objects, focusing on data access and multi-tenant isolation logic.

methods.name: requireEnv()
methods.description: Ensures all required environment variables are set, throwing an error if any are missing.

methods.name: buildWhere(filter = {}, opts = {})
methods.description: Constructs SQL WHERE clauses and corresponding values for filtering by tenant, company, and other filters.

methods.name: insert(table, data, { tenantId, actorUserId })
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the specified table, adding tenant and audit information.

methods.name: update(table, id, patch, { tenantId, actorUserId })
methods.description: Updates an existing record identified by ID in a specified table, with tenant context and audit information.

methods.name: remove(table, id, { tenantId })
methods.description: Deletes a record by ID from the specified table within a tenant context.

methods.name: getById(table, id, { tenantId })
methods.description: Retrieves a record by ID within a tenant context.

methods.name: list(table, filter = {}, { tenantId, companyId, companyScoped = false } = {})
methods.description: Lists records from a table with optional filters, tenant, and company scoping.

methods.name: upsert(table, where, data, { tenantId, actorUserId })
methods.description: Performs an insert or update (upsert) based on the presence of existing records matching the filter.

methods.name: upsertLedgerBalance({ tenantId, companyId, accountId, entry })
methods.description: Updates or inserts ledger balance and entries for a given account and company within a tenant.

ctags.pattern: /^async function list(table, filter = {}, { tenantId, companyId, companyScoped = false } = {}) {$/

ctags.pattern: /^async function upsert(table, where, data, { tenantId, actorUserId }) {$/

ctags.pattern: /^async function upsertLedgerBalance({ tenantId, companyId, accountId, entry }) {$/
